latin: Opus praecedentium hymnorum nullum est sine opere Cabale, cuius est proprium practicare omnem quantitatem formalem, continuam et discretam.

translation: None of the operation belonging to the preceding hymns succeeds without a work of Cabala, whose proper office is to put into practice every formal quantity, both continuous and discrete.
